statement: let I := fun n : ℕ => Finset.Icc ((n+2)/3) ((2*n)/3); let P := fun z : ℕ => (Finset.Icc 2 z).filter Nat.Prime; let V := fun n z : ℕ => ((I n).card:ℝ)*(n.totient:ℝ)/n * ∏ p ∈ (P z).filter (fun p => ¬ p ∣ n), (1-2/(p:ℝ)); let S := fun n z : ℕ => ((I n).filter (fun u => u.Coprime n ∧ z < (u*(n-u)).minFac)).card; let Z₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let Z₂ := Nat.sqrt; ∃ N₀ : ℕ, 64 ≤ N₀ ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, N₀ ≤ n → Even n → V n (Z₁ n) - V n (Z₂ n)/8 ≤ (S n (Z₁ n):ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 中段首次命中的下界筛：z1=n^(1/3) 处幸存数不少于主项减终端误差八分之一（HD6 的 parity/level barrier）。
plain_statement.en: Lower-bound sieve for middle first hits: survivors at z1=n^(1/3) are at least the main term minus one eighth of the terminal error (the HD6 parity/level barrier).
